# Async Behavior

Source: [4843](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4843); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-4843-n1"></a>

- Start Rule's already-running policy is scoped to the same player or global entity.

<a id="wiki-4843-n2"></a>

- Restart Rule replaces contextual values including event player, attacker and victim; Do Nothing lets the running invocation finish without changing its context.
